### The engineering legs — RAN

- `ops/src/ops/scheduled.py`: dataclasses + `load_cadence` extended
  for every new section; `parse_cadence_doc` export.
- `ops/src/ops/live_diff.py` (new, ~1,210 lines): cron syntax +
  semantics lint (DOM&DOW-OR refusal absent `cron_or_semantics_ok`),
  pin lint (tag refusal, expiry enforcement, required `reason`),
  expected-state builders, gcloud/REST live fetchers, fixture
  (`--from-state`) loader, normalisers (Cloud Run v1 service container
  nesting, `valueFrom.secretKeyRef.name`, parsed scheduler override

  0 clean · 1 drift · 2 error (a recorded alert leg can answer 6).

  `--cadence` / `--project` / `--region` / `--gcs-bucket` / `--alert`
  / `--emit-declared`; `cadence --check` now runs cron + pin lint.
